title: Deep Learning Discovers Abaucin, a Narrow-Spectrum Antibiotic Against Multidrug-Resistant A. baumannii
whyItMatters: Used a graph neural network trained on ~7,500 molecules to discover abaucin—a narrow-spectrum antibiotic active against WHO’s critical-priority hospital superbug Acinetobacter baumannii.
summary: Published in Nature Chemical Biology in May 2023 by Gary Liu, Denise Catacutan, Jonathan Stokes (McMaster University), and James J. Collins (MIT / Broad Institute), researchers trained a directed message-passing neural network on growth-inhibition data from ~7,500 compounds and screened the Drug Repurposing Hub in silico. The top structurally novel candidate—named abaucin—exhibited potent narrow-spectrum activity against 41 multidrug-resistant clinical isolates of Acinetobacter baumannii via lipoprotein-trafficking disruption (LolE) while sparing beneficial gut commensals, and successfully controlled infections in a mouse wound model.
technicalHighlights: Identified abaucin (RS-102895) from ~6,680 Drug Repurposing Hub molecules using a message-passing graph neural network trained on ~7,500 empirical screens.
Demonstrated selective, narrow-spectrum inhibition across 41 multidrug-resistant clinical A. baumannii isolates while sparing 50+ commensal microbiome species.
Elucidated a novel antibacterial mechanism (perturbing LolE-mediated lipoprotein trafficking) and confirmed in vivo efficacy in a murine dorsal wound infection model.
caveats: Preclinical lead compound requiring medicinal chemistry optimization, toxicology, and human clinical trials before any therapeutic approval.

scoreRationale.foundational: Proved that Halicin-style molecular deep learning generalizes to narrow-spectrum, mechanism-specific targeting of a critical Gram-negative WHO superbug.
scoreRationale.ripple: Accelerated global AI-driven antimicrobial discovery pipelines targeting multidrug-resistant pathogens without destroying the gut microbiome.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Nature Chemical Biology with mechanistic genetics (LolE mutants) and in vivo mouse wound validation.
scoreRationale.velocity: Screened thousands of candidate compounds computationally in hours to isolate a narrow-spectrum lead.
